note: The Singapore homepage links to https://www.visa.com.sg/en_sg/visa-offers-and-perks/ (the sitemap path /pay-with-visa/visa-offers-and-perks.html redirects here). The listing is an Angular app. Plain HTTP is a js_shell. A headless browser with settle_ms 20000 loads site-config, the AEM locale configuration, locale ids, and POST /offers/api/portal/portal/perks/. Tiles are vs-perk-card. Detail facts come from the public GET https://www.visa.com.sg/offers/api/offer/{id}?locale=en_sg&siteId=www.visa.com.sg, which is the same payload the offer page uses. Scripts and CSS on cdn.visa.com are not fetched: the fetcher treats that host as outside official_domains even though visa.com is listed. The listing still renders from visa.com.sg.
